# Animation Vocabulary Skill for Muse

A reverse-lookup glossary that turns a vague description of a web animation into its exact term: "the bouncy thing when a popover opens" → Pop in; "the iOS rubber-band scroll" → Rubber-banding. It holds a curated vocabulary of entrances and exits, sequencing, transforms, state transitions, scroll effects, interaction feedback, easing, springs, looping motion, polish effects, performance terms, and guiding principles — quoted verbatim from Emil Kowalski's animation philosophy, with disambiguation between close terms (Clip-path vs Mask, Pop in vs Bounce). It names the effect; it does not design or build it. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: intentionally narrow — for "what's it called when…?" questions so you can prompt an AI or a designer with the right word, not a design course. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
